how to geberate radiology invoice

To generate a radiology invoice, follow these steps: 
1. Click on the 'Estimate' button to view estimated bills. 
2. Double-click on the estimated bill to proceed with payment. 
3. Click the 'Save' button to generate the service bill. 
4. A pop-up will appear showing the payable amount details. 
5. Click 'Yes' to generate the invoice bill with a bill number. 
6. If needed, click the 'Reprint' button to load previously billed details for printing. 

For further assistance, you can view the relevant image here: ![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114308.png)

previlage card

The privilege card form is used to view available privilege cards and their utilization details. You can filter and search based on membership number, document number, policy number, and mobile number for easy tracking and management of privilege card activities. Access this screen by clicking the 'Prv.Card' button from the OP service billing screen. All available privilege cards associated with the patient will be displayed along with utilization details. For more information, you can view the relevant image here: ![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113401.png)

Download Referred Services

To download referred services, follow these steps: 
1. Ensure that the referred services are mapped to the same service at the outside investigation center in interbranch item mapping. 
2. After mapping, select the bill you want to download. 
3. Click the 'Download' button to download the referred services. 

If the patient is not already registered in this center, register them by clicking the 'New' button. If the patient is already registered, click 'Existing' to search for the patient based on their registered document ID. 

For further assistance, you can view the relevant image here: ![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113800.png)

patient discount

Various discounts can be applied for patients, such as user-wise limit discount and date-wise discount. If any billing user has the privilege to give a discount, it can be applied on the billing screen up to the limits specified for that particular user. To associate any discount profile with a patient's bill, select the details from the 'Reference' field and then click on the 'Apply' button. A discount will be automatically applied on the bill. For more information, you can view the relevant image here: ![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114457.png)

The Credit Scheme Allocation form is used to allocate a credit scheme to a patient. This screen can be accessed by clicking the F7 button after entering the file number from the OP service billing screen. You need to enter necessary data in the fields such as insurance company name, corporate company name, and scheme name, and then click the save button to allocate the credit scheme. Mandatory fields are colored in red. For more information, you can view the relevant image here: ![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114430.png)

Cscan

The CScan form is used to scan the cards submitted by the patients (e.g., Insurance Card). This screen can be accessed by clicking the 'CScan' button from the OP service billing screen. You can add documents submitted by the patient by clicking the 'Scan' button and view all attached documents by clicking the 'VScan' button. Payments can be made using either cash or card, with options to select credit or debit card. For more information, you can view the relevant image here: ![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114401.png)

what are the fields

The fields that are colored in red in the document are mandatory fields. Here are some of the key fields:
1. **From**: Used to search the bills sent to the external center from a particular date.
2. **To**: Used to search the bills sent to the external center up to a particular date.
3. **Referral No**: Used to search the bills based on referral number.
4. **Services**: Specifies the service type of the bill (e.g., Radiology, Laboratory).
5. **Estimate No**: Used to enter the estimate number.
6. **File No**: Used to enter the file number of the patient.
7. **Doctor**: Used to enter the doctor's name.
8. **Membership No**: Specifies the membership number.
9. **Document Value**: Specifies the document value number.
10. **Policy No**: Specifies the policy number.
11. **Mobile No**: Specifies the mobile number.
12. **Scheme**: Specifies the scheme name.
